chapter_seo_title: A Butcher's Judgment: Danyangzi Trapped by His Ghosts in Dao-Twisted World
chapter_meta_description: Danyangzi faces a terrifying karmic siege: the dead disciples he murdered have returned. His spells fail. Li Huowang asks a haunting question. A psychological horror masterclass.
og_description: Danyangzi is caught in a nightmare of his own making as the spirits of his victims refuse to be silenced.
twitter_description: Nobody escapes their past in the Dao-Twisted World. Danyangzi’s spells are useless against the ghosts he wronged.
